expression_or_partial_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_reuse_children_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, ((scope ->> 'reuse_parent'::text))) WHERE (scope ? 'reuse_parent'::text)

source_contract.authority: Same capability and request re-enter unchanged authentication, active run/fence and task owner/generation/lease checks on every send.
source_contract.effects: Task disposition and optional adaptive limit, provider pacing, credential dependency and exception append are transactional. Earlier committed provider reservation remains.
source_contract.native_error: Selected route does not catch55P03 or manufacture a native four-key HTTP500 envelope; global gate and native failures propagate to the gateway.
source_contract.nontransactional_caveat: Identity sequence advances and database logs can survive abort. They do not permit a business-row reset or an uncertain-write retry.
source_contract.not_idempotent: Successful defer leaves RUNNING and clears owner/lease; there is no matching successful-defer acknowledgement replay branch.
source_contract.provider_boundary: Unchanged worker catches one synthetic ProviderProblem and retries only serialized defer RPC. No provider fetch, reservation or attempt is replayed.
source_contract.public_wrapper: Single transaction calls authenticated dispatcher; normal results are controlled {ok,result/error} envelopes.
